tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "02C25DD64549DBC5DC38008E56E1964D", "Upon Death, some carried Materials are lost. Others remain in your Ash Pile at the site of your Death until reclaimed-or stolen by another player.")
NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "885E386C493818DD94CB908E35386BB0", "Dying also incurs an Experience Debt. A portion of any Experience you earn will go toward repaying it.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "BC3581F34742EC4EF1865385A2216AA8", "For a limited time, a Cleric can resurrect you at the spot where you fell. All penalties of Death still apply. You may choose to Revive at an Emberspring instead.")
